pages.title: A threshold function
pages.text:
A threshold function
def above_threshold(speed, target):
return speed > target
At s∗ = 2, a speed of 2 does not qualify and 2.01 does. Missing and nonﬁnite inputs
require a separate policy.

pages.title: A geometric test suite
pages.text:
A geometric test suite
Translation leaves velocity unchanged. Rotation leaves speed unchanged. Rescaling length
by a rescales speed by |a|.
These relations test the mathematical operation over many
arrays without hard-coding every result.
